translations.caution:
A pre-1955 lay hand missal, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its rubrics, its seasonal second and third orations, its Holy Week and its sanctoral are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

Leaf n672, printed p. 664, heads 26 September `XXVI. SS. CYPRIAN and JUSTINA, mm.`, rubricates `All as in Mass IX. p. 479, except` a proper Collect, and then names `SECRET, (We bring) and P. Comm.(Praesta.) p. 479` -- addressing the two orations by their opening words on that page. `We bring` is Mass VIII's Secret, on leaf n487, printed p. 479, which carries no name and answers the 1962's `Munera tibi, Domine, nostrae devotionis offerimus` word for word. `Praesta` on the same page carries `N. and N.` and is ledgered untranslated. Page-image collation confirms that this historical English body answers the complete target Latin identity; publication is limited to the 1861 wording and does not claim that Cummiskey appoints the 1962 celebration.
